description.p: Jollyboat is a desktop app for Sharkord, the self-hosted chat with voice, video and screen sharing. Add the address of your server and use it like any other app, with a tray icon, global hotkeys and screen shares that include sound.

ul.li: Screen sharing with sound: everything you hear except your own call
Global hotkeys for mute, deafen and push-to-talk, also on Wayland
An optional voice overlay that shows who is talking
A tray icon that shows when you are in a call, talking, muted or deafened, and new messages
Several servers, proxy logins (basic auth), staying logged in and share codes
Asks before a reload or quit would drop you out of a call
Talks only to your servers, no telemetry

description.p: You need a Sharkord server to connect to. Jollyboat is not affiliated with the Sharkord project.

screenshot.caption: On a server, in a voice channel

description.p: Release files follow one naming scheme.

ul.li: Push-to-talk through the desktop's global shortcuts
Optional voice overlay: who is in the call and who talks, on top of other windows
Built from source, with the app ID net.innovativefluid.Jollyboat
Starting with the system goes through the desktop's background permission
Webcams work inside the sandbox through the camera portal

description.p: Experimental macOS build, Windows on ARM, security and privacy pass.
